provenance.method: NECB 2025 verified against the building-codes MCP (necb:2025). Interior LPD values are IDENTICAL to 2020: Table 4.2.1.6 (2025) transcribed in full (lpd_space_functions_2025.json) and joined to the 2020 space-type records by normalized name — 162 exact matches with ZERO value differences (incl. all three atrium bins 4.2/5.2/6.5 W/m2 and manual spot checks of every rename); residual unmatched rows are renames ('Health care facility' -> 'Healthcare facility', the legacy 'Penitentary' typo, atrium bin phrasing) and dwelling units (handled by 8.4.4.5.(2), not the table). Table 4.2.1.5 (2025) also transcribed (lpd_building_types_2025.json).
